name: Trailing Only with Close All Button
summary: This EA is a trade management utility that applies a trailing stop to existing open positions and provides a Close All button on the chart to instantly close all open orders. It does not open any trades on its own; it only manages already-opened positions by modifying their stop loss levels as price moves favorably.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个交易管理工具，对现有持仓应用移动止损（追踪止损），并在图表上提供一个一键全平仓按钮。它不会自行开仓，仅通过在价格朝有利方向移动时修改止损来管理已有仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是移动止损管理，不涉及任何入场信号或开仓逻辑。入场条件方面，EA本身不产生入场信号，完全依赖用户或其他EA手动开仓。出场条件是通过追踪止损机制实现：当价格朝有利方向移动超过指定点数后，止损会跟随移动至保本或盈利位置，若价格回撤触及移动止损则平仓。仓位管理方面，EA不涉及仓位大小计算或开仓手数设定。资金管理方面，仅通过移动止损来锁定已有利润和限制回撤，Close All按钮提供紧急全平仓功能作为风险控制手段。整体而言，这是一个纯粹的持仓管理工具，核心功能是追踪止损和一键全平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is trailing stop management, with no entry signals or order opening logic involved. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not generate any entry signals and relies entirely on the user or another EA to open positions manually. For exit conditions, it implements a trailing stop mechanism: when price moves favorably beyond a specified number of points, the stop loss is moved to breakeven or a profit level, and if price retraces to hit the trailing stop, the position is closed. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not involve any lot size calculation or position opening decisions. For money management, it only protects existing profits and limits drawdown through the trailing stop, while the Close All button provides an emergency full-liquidation function as a risk control measure. Overall, this is a purely position management utility with core functions of trailing stop and one-click close all.

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，价格移动该点数后开始激活止损移动
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop activation distance in points

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 止损移动步长，每次止损调整的最小移动点数

pros: 提供一键全平仓按钮，紧急情况下可快速关闭所有仓位
追踪止损自动管理，无需手动监控每个仓位的止损
纯工具性质不产生新仓位，不会增加额外风险敞口
pros_en: Provides a one-click Close All button for emergency liquidation of all positions
Automates trailing stop management without requiring manual monitoring of each position
Pure utility that does not open new positions, adding no additional risk exposure
cons: 缺乏追踪止损的高级选项，如分步追踪或基于ATR的动态止损
没有仓位筛选功能，Close All按钮无法选择性地关闭特定品种或方向的仓位
缺少图形化面板显示当前各仓位的追踪止损状态和利润信息
cons_en: Lacks advanced trailing options such as step-trailing or ATR-based dynamic trailing stops
No position filtering capability; the Close All button cannot selectively close positions by symbol or direction
Missing a graphical dashboard to display current trailing stop status and profit info for each position
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态追踪止损选项，使止损距离能适应市场波动率变化
添加仓位筛选功能，允许用户按品种、方向或魔术号选择性平仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic trailing stop option so the trailing distance adapts to market volatility changes
Add position filtering functionality allowing users to selectively close positions by symbol, direction, or magic number

risk_points: Close All按钮无二次确认，可能误触导致全部仓位被意外平仓
追踪止损参数设置过小可能在剧烈波动中被频繁触发止损
risk_points_en: Close All button has no confirmation dialog; accidental clicks could unexpectedly close all positions
Trailing stop parameters set too small may trigger stops frequently during high volatility
